title: Règles officielles du marché
text:
This market refers to the tennis match between Semen Pankin and Nikolai Barsukov in the Monastir 2, originally scheduled for November 23, 2026 at 5:00AM ET.

This market will resolve to 'Semen Pankin' if Semen Pankin advances against Nikolai Barsukov.

This market will resolve to 'Nikolai Barsukov' if Nikolai Barsukov advances against Semen Pankin.

If the match is canceled (not played at all), ends in a tie, or a winner has not been determined by December 7, 2026, 11:59 PM ET (14 days after the scheduled start), this market will resolve to 50-50.

If the match begins but is not completed, and one player advances due to the opponent's retirement, default, or disqualification, this market will resolve to the player who advances.

If the match ends in a walkover (player withdraws before the start and the other advances automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50.

The primary resolution source will be official information from the ATP Tour. A consensus of credible reporting may also be used.
